program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-entry deep passes; consolidate and validate once after Wave 2500

source_provenance: Public PubMed/PMC abstracts and ordinary web research
manual clinical-identity, route, formulation, population, observational, food-matrix, exposure-safety, evidence-conflict and safety calibration

policy.validation_strategy: deep source calibration per pass; expensive repository-wide validation after Wave 2500

rejected_candidates.title: The role of collagen types I and II in the regeneration of temporomandibular joint and bone tissues - from molecular mechanisms to modern treatment protocols: Literature review.
rejected_candidates.reason: injectable/tissue-regeneration collagen biology rather than collagen supplementation evidence

waves.title: Evaluating probiotic monotherapy in Helicobacter pylori infection: A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials with trial sequential analysis.
waves.study: meta-analysis of 28 randomized controlled trials with trial sequential analysis
waves.population: people with H. pylori infection receiving probiotic monotherapy without antibiotics
waves.finding: Probiotic monotherapy reduced H. pylori colonization versus placebo, but complete eradication remained low at 16.8%; Lactobacillus reuteri and four-week regimens showed larger subgroup signals.
waves.safety: Strain and duration effects were heterogeneous, and low eradication rates mean probiotics should not be represented as a replacement for established eradication therapy.

waves.title: Effects of a Plant-Based Multi-Strain Limosilactobacillus fermentum Probiotic on Weight Loss Outcomes in Overweight and Obese Adults: A Preliminary Study.
waves.population: adults with overweight completing a 500-kcal/day energy deficit plus 10,000-step/day walking program
waves.finding: Both groups lost weight and fat; the proprietary three-strain L. fermentum blend produced a greater reduction in fat mass and some central-adiposity measures than placebo.
waves.safety: The probiotic effect was tested on top of structured calorie restriction and walking and is specific to a proprietary strain blend.

waves.title: ω-3 Fatty Acids in Pediatric Major Depressive Disorder: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
waves.study: multicenter double-blind placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial
waves.population: 257 youths with moderate-to-severe major depressive disorder receiving standardized psychotherapy
waves.finding: EPA+DHA at 1.5 g/day did not outperform placebo for depressive symptoms, response, remission, quality of life, or suicidality through 36 weeks.
waves.safety: Serious adverse events occurred in both groups and none were judged causally related to study medication; this is a strong direct pediatric efficacy null.

waves.title: Role of curcumin and its nanoformulations in the management of oral squamous cell carcinoma: A systematic review.
waves.population: 30 cell-line studies and 5 clinical studies involving oral squamous cell carcinoma
waves.finding: Curcumin and nanoformulations consistently inhibited growth and related tumor pathways in cell-line studies, but the evidence base was overwhelmingly preclinical with only five clinical studies.
waves.safety: Cell-line antitumor effects do not establish efficacy for prevention or treatment of oral cancer in humans.

waves.title: Enteral When Compared With IV Magnesium Replacement in the Critically Ill: A Noninferiority Randomized Clinical Trial.
waves.population: 360 critically ill patients with mild-to-moderate hypomagnesemia
waves.finding: Enteral magnesium did not establish noninferiority to IV magnesium for 24-hour serum magnesium correction, although it reduced urinary magnesium, cost, waste, carbon emissions, and IV-fluid use; other clinical outcomes did not differ.
waves.safety: This is ICU electrolyte-replacement evidence comparing enteral and IV routes, not routine magnesium-supplement efficacy in community populations.

waves.title: Mechanistic Insights into Bisphenol A-Mediated Male Infertility: Potential Role of Panax Ginseng Extract.
waves.population: predominantly experimental literature on BPA reproductive toxicity and Panax ginseng
waves.finding: The review describes plausible antioxidant, androgenic, and spermatogenesis-related mechanisms by which Panax ginseng could counter BPA-associated male reproductive toxicity.
waves.safety: The argument is primarily mechanistic/preclinical and does not establish that ginseng treats BPA-related infertility in humans.

waves.title: Vitamin D for multiple sclerosis as an adjuvant therapy: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
waves.study: network meta-analysis of 32 randomized controlled trials
waves.population: 2,254 adults with multiple sclerosis
waves.finding: This synthesis found long-term vitamin D reduced relapse risk and modestly improved EDSS, with high-dose long-duration regimens ranking highest; serious adverse events did not differ significantly.
waves.safety: The conclusions conflict with other recent vitamin-D/MS syntheses that find little overall benefit, and high-dose subgroup/network rankings should not be converted into dosing recommendations.

waves.title: Comparative efficacy of biweekly preventive supplementation, with multiple micronutrients and iron folic acid or iron folic acid alone, on hemoglobin concentrations and anemia prevalence in children aged 6-59 months: a randomized controlled trial in rural India.
waves.population: 1,300 children aged 6-59 months in rural India
waves.finding: Adding multiple micronutrients to biweekly iron-folic acid produced only a 0.12 g/dL hemoglobin advantage and reduced anemia prevalence from 24.0% to 17.6%, without improving biochemical iron or other micronutrient markers.
waves.safety: The authors concluded the incremental value was minimal where iron-folic-acid adherence was already high; the setting and pediatric preventive program are population-specific.

waves.title: From Ancient Spice to Advanced Science: Therapeutic, Nutraceutical and Nanotechnological Insights into the Fruits of Piper Longum Linn for Modern Drug Development.
waves.population: preclinical, formulation, and limited translational literature
waves.finding: Piper longum constituents such as piperine and piperlongumine show antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, metabolic, and anticancer activities in experimental systems, with nanotechnology proposed to improve delivery.
waves.safety: The review is predominantly mechanistic and drug-development focused; it does not establish human clinical efficacy for Piper longum supplementation.

waves.title: A randomized trial of iron- and zinc-biofortified pearl millet-based complementary feeding in children aged 12-18 months living in urban slums.
waves.population: 223 children aged 12-18 months in Mumbai
waves.finding: Iron/zinc-biofortified pearl millet modestly increased hemoglobin and reduced anemia prevalence versus conventional millet but did not improve ferritin, plasma zinc, or growth.
waves.safety: This is a biofortified complementary-food intervention in infants, not isolated iron/zinc supplement evidence.

waves.title: Ginseng Biomacromolecules: Integrating Nutrition and Health, a New Direction in Phytomedicine.
waves.population: mixed laboratory and translational evidence on ginseng polysaccharides, pectin, exosomes, proteins, and fiber
waves.finding: The review catalogs structural and mechanistic evidence for ginseng biomacromolecules across metabolic, immune, and other biological functions.
waves.safety: Clinical efficacy and standardized human exposure are not established for these complex macromolecular fractions.

waves.title: Melatonin in cancer treatment.
waves.study: Cochrane systematic review of randomized controlled trials
waves.population: adults with cancer receiving melatonin alone or alongside standard treatment
waves.finding: Evidence was too uncertain to establish effects on quality of life or sleep; melatonin probably reduced fatigue and may reduce nausea when added to standard treatment.
waves.safety: Most outcomes were low or very-low certainty with high risk of bias and insufficient adverse-event data, so adjunctive use remains uncertain.

waves.title: Effects of Ashwagandha on Reproductive Health: A Systematic Review of Sex-Specific Hormonal and Fertility Outcomes.
waves.study: systematic review of preclinical and clinical research
waves.population: mixed male and female reproductive-health literature
waves.finding: The review reports possible improvements in sperm, hormonal, sexual-health, and selected female reproductive outcomes, but the literature mixes preclinical and heterogeneous clinical studies.
waves.safety: Long-term effects, dosing, formulation, and clinical reproductive outcomes remain insufficiently established.

waves.title: A Randomized Trial of Vitamin D Supplementation and COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes and Long COVID: The Vitamin D for COVID-19 Trial.
waves.population: 1,747 adults with newly diagnosed COVID-19 plus 277 household contacts
waves.finding: Vitamin D3 did not significantly reduce four-week healthcare utilization or other acute COVID-19 treatment/prevention outcomes versus placebo; a per-protocol long-COVID signal at eight weeks was nonsignificant.
waves.safety: No safety concern was identified, but the acute clinical efficacy result was null and the long-COVID finding remains exploratory.

waves.title: Effects of Probiotics and Synbiotics Supplementation on Blood Pressure in Adults with Prediabetes and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Grade-Assessed Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis.
waves.population: 1,281 adults with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes
waves.finding: Probiotic/synbiotic supplementation reduced systolic blood pressure by about 3.3 mmHg and diastolic pressure by about 1.8 mmHg in pooled analyses.
waves.safety: Interventions pooled different strains and synbiotic formulations; dose-response analyses do not establish a universal probiotic regimen.

waves.title: Efficacy of probiotic supplementation in influencing cognitive function in Alzheimer's disease: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.study: meta-analysis of 4 double-blind randomized controlled trials
waves.population: 251 adults aged 65 or older with clinically diagnosed Alzheimer's disease
waves.finding: Probiotics improved pooled cognitive scores versus placebo, but heterogeneity was high and only four trials were available.
waves.safety: Formulations, doses, and baseline disease severity varied; the small heterogeneous evidence base does not justify a class-wide cognitive claim.

waves.title: Systematic review of adverse human health effects following oral exposure to inorganic nitrate and nitrite.
waves.population: human oral nitrate/nitrite exposure from food, drinking water, and other sources
waves.finding: The review found more consistent evidence of increased risk for selected urinary-tract, prostate, and thyroid cancers, type 2 diabetes, and birth defects under some exposure conditions, while exposure characterization varied widely.
waves.safety: This is broad environmental/dietary exposure toxicology and cannot be directly mapped onto beetroot or sports-nitrate supplements without source, dose, and co-exposure distinctions.

waves.title: The effect of probiotics on weight management in patients with severe obesity undergoing metabolic and bariatric surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.population: 693 patients undergoing metabolic/bariatric surgery
waves.finding: Probiotics did not significantly improve excess weight loss, postoperative BMI, or BMI reduction, and subgroup analyses did not identify clinically meaningful benefits.
waves.safety: Strong direct null for postoperative weight-loss enhancement, but the surgical population and strain heterogeneity limit generalization to other indications.

waves.title: Comparative effectiveness of probiotics, prebiotics, synbiotics, and postbiotics in preventing dental caries: a meta-analysis from an oral microbiota modulation perspective.
waves.population: children and adults in dental-caries prevention studies
waves.finding: Probiotics modestly reduced new/progressive caries in children but not adults; evidence for prebiotics, synbiotics, and postbiotics was sparse and mainly microbiological.
waves.safety: Pediatric benefit was modest and strain/delivery specific; other biotic classes remain insufficiently validated.

waves.title: Effect of continuous energy restriction combined with probiotic supplementation on parameters related to homeostatic and hedonic systems of food intake in adult men living with obesity: Data from a randomized, parallel, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
waves.population: adult men with obesity undergoing 30% continuous energy restriction
waves.finding: Energy restriction reduced fat mass and improved eating-behavior measures, but probiotics produced no significant additional group-by-time benefit for appetite hormones, eating behavior, or body-fat outcomes.
waves.safety: The trial was underpowered for some outcomes and probiotic effects were tested only as an adjunct to substantial caloric restriction.

waves.title: Effect of probiotic supplement on improvement of depressive symptoms in patients with substance-induced depressive disorder: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial.
waves.population: 40 adults with substance-induced depressive disorder
waves.finding: Depression and anxiety improved over time in both groups, but probiotic supplementation did not significantly outperform placebo; inflammatory-marker changes were only nonsignificant trends.
waves.safety: Small pilot but clinically valuable direct null evidence in a substance-use population; no efficacy claim is supported.

waves.title: Efficacy of curcumin in the management of oral submucous fibrosis: an umbrella review.
waves.population: people with oral submucous fibrosis
waves.finding: Curcumin improved burning sensation in pooled analyses, while other clinical symptoms were not significantly improved and overlap/heterogeneity across reviews was substantial.
waves.safety: The umbrella review characterizes benefits as limited and best considered adjunctive rather than standalone treatment.

waves.title: Magnesium administration for vasospasm prevention in acute aneurysmal SAH: a multicenter randomized controlled trial.
waves.population: 121 patients with acute aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage
waves.finding: IV magnesium sulfate improved transcranial-Doppler hemodynamic markers during the peak vasospasm window but did not significantly reduce vasospasm incidence, delayed cerebral ischemia, length of stay, or 30-day functional outcome.
waves.safety: No serious-adverse-event difference was found; this is high-acuity IV therapy and not oral magnesium-supplement evidence.

waves.title: Vitamin D Supplementation, Total Testosterone, and Androgen Bioavailability Markers in Adult Men: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
waves.study: systematic review/meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
waves.population: adult men across 21 comparison-level datasets
waves.finding: Vitamin D supplementation did not clearly or reproducibly improve total testosterone, SHBG, free androgen index, calculated free testosterone, or bioactive testosterone.
waves.safety: GRADE certainty was low to very low, but the available randomized evidence does not support a testosterone-boosting claim.

waves.title: Determination of Folate Bioavailability From Brewer's Yeast in a Dual Isotope Randomized Human Intervention Study.
waves.study: randomized human dual-isotope pilot bioavailability study
waves.population: 6 healthy volunteers, with 5 evaluable for the primary bioavailability estimate
waves.finding: Natural folates embedded in brewer's yeast had mean bioavailability of about 74% relative to 5-methyltetrahydrofolate in this isotope-tracer model.
waves.safety: Tiny pilot measuring pharmacokinetics/food-matrix bioavailability rather than clinical efficacy; it should not be used to infer disease benefit.
